title: Hazard visible: Blue car
detail: First seen 35 m ahead, 11.3 m left of the camera's line, with the camera vehicle at 41 km/h.

title: Time-to-collision below 3.0 s
detail: 10.0 m apart and closing at 12 km/h at T-3.2 s.

title: Time-to-collision below 1.5 s
detail: 12.6 m apart and closing at 54 km/h at T-2.7 s.

title: Could it have stopped?
detail: 1.6 s before impact Black motorcycle was at 46 km/h with 26.0 m to go. A full stop (1 s reaction + braking) needs 24.7 m. A stop was possible; the highest speed that would have allowed a stop is about 72 km/h.

title: Braking began 1.5 s before impact
detail: At 46 km/h with 24.3 m left to the impact point. Braking alone needs about 12.0 m to stop from that speed, so a stop was possible.

title: Reaction time ≈ 1.7 s
detail: Braking began 1.7 s after the hazard reached a 3 s time-to-collision (typical perception-reaction time is 1.0–1.5 s).

title: Speed before impact ≈ 65 ± 22 km/h
detail: Average speed of the camera vehicle over the last second, estimated from how fast the road surface streams past (±30%).

title: Closest approach: Blue car
detail: Blue car came within 1.5 m of Black motorcycle's body (2.5 m centre to centre) at T+0.0 s.
